description.content: ListConversationCounts retrieves a time-series of the unique conversation counts.

query.description: Required. Start time of the listing. REST query parameter is "start_time". Its value will be truncated down to nearest midnight in given time zone and internally converted to UTC after.

Required. End of the listing up to this time, not inclusive. REST query parameter is "end_time". Its value will be rounded up to the nearest midnight in given time zone and internally converted to UTC after.

Required. Aggregate conversation counts in interval buckets over the requested time period. REST query parameter is "agg_interval" with valid values: DAY or WEEK.

 - DAY: Metrics will be aggregated in 24 hour intervals
 - WEEK: Metrics will be aggregated in 168 hour intervals
Filter conversation counts by collection_id. REST query parameter is "collection_id". The conversation counts must be filtered by either collection or solution.

Filter conversation counts by solution_id. REST query parameter is "solution_id". The conversation counts must be filtered by either collection or solution. This filter takes precedence over collection_id which it disables.

# Introduction
The Pryon API blah blah blah.

# Authentication
When you sign up for an account, you are given your set of API credentials.


Pryon supports authentication in the form of JSON Web Tokens.
- JWT: authenticates each request by the http header: Authorization

For all API requests, you will have to include the Authorization header in the following form:

```javascript
Authorization: Bearer {encoded token}
```
